In the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] maintained a private '''task force''' that answered directly to him. This task force was part of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. It is possible that this team dissolved after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Solo as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus in [[41 ABY]] at [[Shedu Maad]].
